About the Girls Rock Monthly Ride group ride

A free monthly women's mountain bike ride on Santa Cruz trails. Riders check in, split into groups by level with volunteer guides, and roll out at 10 am. First-timers are welcome. Register online before you come; the start venue changes month to month.
